title: Irreducible factorization of polynomials over a field
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $P\in K[T]$ be a nonzero polynomial [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. There exist $u\in K^\times$, an integer $r\geq0$ and irreducible polynomials $p_1,\ldots,p_r\in K[T]$, repetitions allowed, such that $P=u\prod_{j=1}^rp_j$; for $r=0$ the product is $1$. Here $p$ is irreducible if it is nonzero, is not a unit of $K[T]$, and in every factorization $p=ab$ in $K[T]$ one of $a,b$ is a unit.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: WfDvdMonoid.exists_factors P hP (Mathlib/RingTheory/UniqueFactorizationDomain/Defs.lean:77-85, hypotheses at 43-49) gives a finite multiset f of irreducibles and Associated f.prod P, that is a polynomial unit v with f.prod * v = P (Associated, Mathlib/Algebra/GroupWithZero/Associated.lean:29-30). Polynomial.isUnit_iff (Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Degree/Units.lean:48-53, hypotheses at 28-29) writes v = C u for a unit u of K; commutativity and an enumeration of f give exactly P = u product_j p_j, allowing f empty. The inferred polynomial UFD instance is Polynomial.uniqueFactorizationMonoid at Mathlib/RingTheory/Polynomial/UniqueFactorization.lean:92-94. The coefficient field is a UFD via Field.toEuclideanDomain (Mathlib/Algebra/EuclideanDomain/Field.lean:25), EuclideanDomain.to_principal_ideal_domain (Mathlib/RingTheory/PrincipalIdealDomain.lean:287), PrincipalIdealRing.to_uniqueFactorizationMonoid (same file:371-373); UniqueFactorizationMonoid extends well-founded divisibility (Defs.lean:135-137), supplying WfDvdMonoid. All indicated source lines were read on 2026-10-24. The node defines irreducibility inline by nonzero, nonunit, and the unit-factor property, which is Mathlib Irreducible in the nontrivial domain K[X].
